description: The First Evil begins eliminating potential Slayers around the world, turning Buffy’s home into a refuge and training ground as she prepares a growing army for a final confrontation beneath Sunnydale.

s07e01.description: Dawn starts at the rebuilt Sunnydale High, where Buffy discovers vengeful spirits beneath the school, while Spike’s return is marked by severe instability and Willow continues recovering in England.

s07e02.description: A vengeance wish transforms a wronged man into a giant subterranean creature, while Buffy discovers the startling reason Spike has changed so profoundly since leaving Sunnydale.

s07e03.description: Willow returns home but a magical block makes her and her friends unable to perceive each other, leaving Willow alone against a demon that slowly strips skin from its victims.

s07e04.description: Working as a school counselor, Buffy tries to protect a student who calmly predicts her own imminent death and learns that supernatural power cannot solve every tragedy.

s07e05.description: After Anya’s latest vengeance wish causes a massacre, Buffy decides she must stop her former friend, while Xander searches for another way to free Anya from the choices she has made.

s07e06.description: An enchanted varsity jacket makes Dawn, Buffy, Willow and Anya obsess over the same student, leaving Xander and Spike to identify and neutralize the spell before someone gets killed.

s07e07.description: Buffy speaks with a newly risen former classmate, Dawn receives a disturbing visitation and Willow is approached by an entity claiming to carry a message from Tara as the First begins revealing itself.

s07e08.description: A string of murders points toward Spike, forcing Buffy to investigate whether his soul has failed while Spike begins realizing that something may be controlling him without his knowledge.

s07e09.description: Spike is restrained in the Summers house while the gang studies his trigger, and Andrew returns from Mexico only to become another captive after the First manipulates him into murder.

s07e10.description: Giles arrives with potential Slayers fleeing a worldwide campaign of killings, while Buffy confronts the First’s ancient Turok-Han vampire and searches for a way to rescue Spike.

s07e11.description: Buffy turns the potential Slayers’ fear into a training exercise by deliberately confronting the Turok-Han in front of them, then launches a rescue for Spike.

s07e12.description: Buffy and Spike begin combat training for the potential Slayers while Willow’s spell suggests that another potential may already be living somewhere in Sunnydale.

s07e13.description: A spell triggered by Amy transforms Willow into Warren after she kisses Kennedy, while Buffy turns to the remnants of the Initiative for help with Spike’s malfunctioning chip.

s07e14.description: Buffy goes on a date with Principal Wood and learns his mother was a Slayer, while Xander’s own date once again proves to have a dangerous supernatural agenda.

s07e15.description: A potential Slayer’s suicide shakes the household, and Buffy uses an ancient artifact to cross into another realm seeking answers about the origin of the Slayer and the coming war.

s07e16.description: Andrew films the group as if making a documentary while supernatural violence spreads through Sunnydale High, forcing him to confront the murder he committed under the First’s influence.

s07e17.description: Giles and Principal Wood attempt to use Spike’s old trigger against him and kill him, while Spike relives the painful relationship with his mother that shaped the man he became.

s07e18.description: Faith returns as the First’s powerful agent Caleb arrives, and Buffy leads the potentials into a disastrous confrontation that leaves several dead or badly injured.

s07e19.description: After another defeat by Caleb, Buffy insists on returning to his base, but the exhausted potential Slayers and Buffy’s friends reject her leadership and force her to leave her own house.

s07e20.description: Spike finds and comforts an isolated Buffy while Faith takes command of the potentials, and both groups independently prepare attacks based on information taken from the First’s forces.

s07e21.description: A bomb devastates Faith’s team while Buffy discovers a powerful ancient scythe, defeats Caleb with it and receives unexpected help from Angel as the final battle approaches.

s07e22.description: Buffy and Willow use the scythe to awaken Slayer power in every potential, then lead a final assault on the First’s army beneath Sunnydale as Spike’s amulet changes the outcome of the war.
